statement: For the 3 by 3 Birkhoff polytope with the Frobenius norm, minimizing over every nonempty proper face G as defined in source.md, Phi(B_3)=1/sqrt(2). The minimizing faces are exactly one orbit under the specified group generated by independent row and column permutations and transposition: the six edges whose two permutation vertices have relative permutation a 3-cycle, represented by conv{P_123,P_231}.
contribution: A complete exact resolution of the frozen finite statement: exhaustive support-closure enumeration reduces all 48 nonempty proper faces to five symmetry orbits, exact rational projection/KKT certificates determine all five affine-hull distances, and containment plus the global affine-hull reduction proves the value and complete equality-orbit classification. No literature-priority, full-automorphism-group, or general-n claim is made.
